| f1 | defect | MAJOR | The operator's live settings.json is rewritten by a non-atomic, unlocked read-modify-write.<br><br>CLAIM: `ensure_home` reads the file (L145), plans against that snapshot, then `fs::write(&path, contents)` (L190) truncates and rewrites the whole document in place. There is no temp-file-plus-rename, no lock, and no re-read before the write.<br><br>PROOF: read the sequence at claude_settings.rs:145-198 — `fs::read_to_string`, then `fs::copy` for the backup, then `fs::write` over the original path. `fs::write` opens with truncate; the file is empty on disk for the interval between truncation and the last byte. Two independent facts make the window reachable rather than theoretical: (1) this now runs on the operator's REAL `~/.claude` at daemon boot AND on every Claude registration (registration.rs:138), so concurrent Claude seats registering are concurrent writers to one path; (2) Claude Code writes that same file itself at runtime (`/permissions`, the update-config path), so the competing writer is not hypothetical. Any change written between our read and our write is silently discarded — we rewrite the entire document from a stale in-memory copy. A crash or a full disk inside the window leaves a truncated settings.json, and the only recovery is a hand-copy from the timestamped backup.<br><br>Why it matters more than the usual write-race: the payload here is the operator's whole configuration, the loser of the race is a change the operator or Claude just made, and nothing reports the loss.<br><br>SMALLEST FIX: write to `settings.json.tmp-&lt;pid&gt;` in the same directory and `fs::rename` over the target. Rename is atomic within a filesystem, which removes the truncation window and makes concurrent ensures last-write-wins on a whole valid document rather than interleaved. That is a few lines in `ensure_home` and changes no signature. (Closing the read-modify-write race fully needs a lock or a compare-before-write; the rename alone removes the corruption mode and is the disproportionate share of the value.) | crates/harnesses/src/claude_settings.rs:190 | — | — | — | — | — | claude_settings.rs:145-198 read directly; call sites confirmed at cli/src/main.rs:880 and daemon/src/registration.rs:138 |
